name: @kauro/migration-worker
description: Kauro migration worker (B14-A): the entrypoint of one processing attempt in an isolated process. It verifies its closed attempt ticket (KAURO_ATTEMPT_TICKET_V1), runs Migration Core 3.0.0 through the B05 adapter inside the B08 attempt envelope, stages the B13 PDF report beside the package and reports its one result; every object through its host's storage broker, no database connection and no credential of its own.
